keyed.HH.UI.Settings.ThisSaveTip: Edit the settings of the running colony. They are saved with it.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.TemplateTip: Edit the template that new colonies start from. The running colony is not changed.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.TemplateOnly: Template for new games. Each new colony gets its own copy.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.EditingTemplate: Editing the template for new games. The running colony is not changed.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.SaveAsTemplateTip: Copies modules, difficulty and all settings of this colony into the template for new games.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.SaveAsTemplateConfirm: Replace the template for new games with the settings of this colony?
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.ApplyTemplateTip: Replaces the settings of this colony with the template.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.ApplyTemplateConfirm: Replace modules, difficulty and all settings of this colony with the template? This cannot be undone.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.NoMatch: No setting matches. Nerd settings are hidden unless you switch them on.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.NerdTip: Shows the settings meant for people who like numbers. Everything else is unchanged.
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.ResetModuleConfirm: Reset every setting of {0} to its default?
keyed.HH.UI.Settings.ModuleIsOff: This module is switched off for this colony. Its settings have no effect.
keyed.HH.UI.Row.FreeTip: Free entry: type any number up to the technical limit of the game.
keyed.HH.UI.Row.Beyond: Beyond the slider range. Free entry allows this.
keyed.HH.UI.Row.LimitGeneric: The game cannot use this value, so the nearest possible one is used.
keyed.HH.UI.Row.FollowsTier: The default follows the hosting difficulty.
keyed.HH.UI.General.ShowCard: Show the first-start card in every new game
keyed.HH.UI.General.ShowCardTip: Off: new games quietly use the template and no card appears.
keyed.HH.UI.Modules.IntroSave: Modules can be switched per colony. A module that is off has no visible effect at all.
keyed.HH.UI.Modules.IntroTemplate: Modules for new colonies. Each colony can still change its own.
keyed.HH.UI.Modules.BankHint: Bank: use the bank inside Hearth & Harbor and switch all guest modules off. You do not need the standalone entry.
keyed.HH.UI.Modules.ContentDesc: How dark the optional content may get. Never sexual content, whatever you pick.
keyed.HH.UI.Content.Standard.Tip: The default. Rough edges, nothing nasty.
keyed.HH.UI.Content.Dark.Tip: Adds to Standard: prisoners may fight to the death, be questioned harder and be hunted (with a fitting ideology), and an organ clinic and the dark menu become possible.
keyed.HH.UI.Content.Grim.Tip: Adds to Dark: hunting prisoners needs no fitting ideology, and organ buyers place orders with deadlines.
keyed.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Inn: Guests, guest beds, wings, reception, travellers and recruiting.
keyed.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.ShopsFood: Venue signs, shops, vending, markets, restaurants and dishes.
keyed.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Casino: Tables, slot machines, chips and the risks of gambling for guests and colonists.
keyed.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.CityLife: Cinema, mall, salon, temples, taxis and security.
keyed.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Underworld: A discreet back room, a fight pit and a fence. Nothing of it happens until you build it.
keyed.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Bank: Silverline: accounts, payments, ATMs, investments, loans, insurance and lottery.
keyed.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.AiFlavour: Optional flavour texts written by an AI through a relay. Off by default.
keyed.HH.UI.Diff.Title: Hosting difficulty
keyed.HH.UI.Diff.Calculator: What this tier means for you
keyed.HH.UI.Diff.ShowAll: Show all {0} values that follow the difficulty
keyed.HH.UI.Diff.WarnHard: From Overbooked on, underworld incidents can cost real goodwill, renown and silver (see the caps below).
keyed.HH.UI.Diff.WarnEasy: This tier is very forgiving. Money comes easy and nothing goes wrong.
keyed.HH.UI.Diff.WarnBreaks: This breaks the game balance. On purpose?
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.SetByYou: You changed this value yourself, so it does not follow the slider.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.NoEffectInfinite: No effect while Infinite guest money is on.
keyed.HH.UI.Feel.1: Money flows and nothing goes wrong.
keyed.HH.UI.Feel.3: Small losses are possible. Profit takes work.
keyed.HH.UI.Feel.4: Underworld incidents start to cost goodwill, renown and fines.
keyed.HH.UI.Feel.5: Bigger penalties for underworld incidents, a harder bank.
keyed.HH.UI.Feel.6: Everything is hard and nothing is capped.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.guestMoney.Desc: Multiplies what guests carry and are willing to spend.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.priceTolerance.Desc: How far above a fair price guests still buy.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.expectation.Desc: Added to what every guest expects. Higher is harder to satisfy.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.bankM.Desc: Yearly multiplier of the Silverline market. 1.2 means plus twenty percent.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.collectionStage.Desc: How rough debt collection can get when you owe money.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.researchCost.Desc: Multiplies the cost of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline research.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.insuranceLoading.Desc: The insurer's markup on top of a fair premium.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.salesPressure.Desc: How pushy the insurer's sales tricks get.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.addiction.Desc: Base chance that a colonist who gambles a lot becomes addicted.
keyed.HH.UI.Ladder.Goodwill.Desc: The most goodwill one underworld incident can take away from you.
keyed.HH.UI.Ladder.Renown.Desc: The most renown one underworld incident can cost you.
keyed.HH.UI.Ladder.Fine.Desc: The most a single underworld incident can fine you.
keyed.HH.UI.Ladder.Footer: These caps apply to underworld incidents. The bank collection stages follow their own settings.
keyed.HH.UI.Diag.PrepareRemovalTip: Gets the colony ready for taking the mod out: guests go home, open accounts are settled, special items are cleaned up.
keyed.HH.UI.Diag.PrepareRemovalConfirm: Prepare this colony for removing Hearth & Harbor? Guests are sent home and accounts are settled. Save a backup first.
keyed.HH.UI.Diag.RemovalDone: Done. Save the game, then remove the mod.
keyed.HH.UI.Diag.NeedsSave: Open a colony first. Preparing removal works on a running game.
keyed.HH.UI.Diag.Summary: {0} settings registered · {1} warnings · {2} errors in the log
keyed.HH.UI.About.Body: Hearth & Harbor turns your colony into a host: guests, inns and hotels, shops and restaurants, a casino, a spa, city life, a discreet back room and Silverline, a full bank. Nothing is forced on you. Until you mark a guest bed or put up a sign, the game plays like vanilla.
keyed.HH.UI.About.PartsBody: Silverline bank included: {0}. Guest modules included: {1}.
keyed.HH.UI.Card.Title: Welcome to Hearth & Harbor
keyed.HH.UI.Card.Sub: Pick your hosting style. Everything can be changed later in the mod settings.
keyed.HH.UI.Card.SubJoined: Nothing changes until you build something for guests. Pick how you want to host.
keyed.HH.UI.Card.UseForAll: Use these choices for all future games
keyed.HH.UI.Card.UseForAllTip: Copies modules, difficulty and tutorial level into the template that new games start from.
keyed.HH.UI.Preset.JustWork.Desc: Standard difficulty, everything on. Start building, we explain on the way.
keyed.HH.UI.Preset.CozyInn.Desc: Gentler, with fewer ways to lose: no casino and no underworld.
keyed.HH.UI.Preset.Tycoon.Desc: Everything on with a short guide. Staff, bookings and the ledger are yours to run.
keyed.HH.UI.Preset.Nerd.Desc: Every slider, formulas and nerd settings. No guide.
keyed.HH.UI.Tutorial.FullFirstTime.Tip: Full guide in the first colony with this mod, short afterwards.
keyed.HH.UI.Tutorial.AlwaysFull.Tip: Topics open on first contact, every time.
keyed.HH.UI.Storyteller.Head: HOSTING DIFFICULTY · {0} %
keyed.HH.UI.Storyteller.Tip: How hard hosting guests gets in this colony. It is separate from the raid difficulty above.
keyed.HH.UI.Overview.IncomeTip: Silver paid into your tills since dawn.
keyed.HH.UI.Overview.VenuesTip: Rooms with a venue sign on the current map.
keyed.HH.UI.Overview.BankTip: Balance of the colony account at Silverline.
keyed.HH.UI.Overview.NoIncome: No income yet. It shows up here as soon as a guest pays.
keyed.HH.UI.Overview.Arrivals: Arrivals, next 24 h: {0}, about {1} groups a day expected.
keyed.HH.UI.Guests.Head: Guests · {0} here · {1} day guests
keyed.HH.UI.Guests.VanillaNote: The Inn module is off, so ordinary visitors are shown.
keyed.HH.UI.Guests.SatTip: How happy this guest is, from -1 to +1. Latest reasons:
keyed.HH.UI.Guests.Col.Name: Guest
keyed.HH.UI.Guests.HandlingTip: Click to switch the handling. Accompany, Recruit and Convert need colonists with Hosting work; Convert only shows for guests of another ideoligion (Ideology).
keyed.HH.UI.Venue.ClosedTip: Outside its opening hours. Change the hours on the venue sign.
keyed.HH.UI.Venue.NoStaffTip: Open, but nobody is on duty. Give a colonist Serving work (or let the venue run without staff on its sign).
keyed.HH.UI.Venue.NoStockTip: Nothing to sell in the room. Put goods, drinks or meals on a shelf or stockpile inside it.
keyed.HH.UI.GuestTab.Label: Guest
keyed.HH.UI.GuestTab.NoInfo: No guest record for this pawn.
keyed.HH.UI.GuestTab.SatisfactionTip: From -1 (furious) to +1 (delighted). It drives renown, goodwill and whether the guest comes back.
keyed.HH.UI.Handling.Basics.Tip: Paid services only, no entertainment. Costs no colonist time.
keyed.HH.UI.Handling.Accompany.Tip: Colonists on Hosting entertain this guest and show them around: mood +1 to +4 by social skill. Costs colonist time. Without a colonist on Hosting it stays Basics.
keyed.HH.UI.Handling.Recruit.Tip: Like Accompany, plus recruitment talks. A clumsy talk can offend: mood -6, 30 % less spending, leaves half a day early.
keyed.HH.UI.Handling.Convert.Tip: Like Accompany, plus talks about your ideoligion. Each talk shakes the guest's certainty in their own; at zero they take on yours. A pushy talk can offend (mood -4, less spending). Needs the Ideology DLC and a guest of another ideoligion.
keyed.HH.UI.DevGroup.Label: Dev: Hearth & Harbor
keyed.HH.UI.DevGroup.Desc: Dev-mode tools of Hearth & Harbor for this building ({0}). Only shown in dev mode; switch the grouping off in the Inn settings.
keyed.HH.UI.Guide.Title: Hearth & Harbor Guide
keyed.HH.UI.Guide.TitleTip: Right-click to hide. You can bring it back in the Hearth & Harbor tab or the settings.
keyed.HH.UI.Guide.Hidden: Guide hidden. Bring it back with the Guide button in the Hearth & Harbor tab or in the settings.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.windowScale.Desc: All Hearth & Harbor and Silverline windows grow or shrink by this factor (on top of the automatic size for large screens).
keyed.HH.Setting.core.researchCost.Desc: Multiplies the cost of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline research projects. Follows the hosting difficulty.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.neverDie.Desc: Guests are knocked down instead of killed. They keep living, downed, until someone tends them.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.infiniteMoney.Desc: Guests who arrive while this is on carry a bottomless purse. The guest money factor has no effect on them.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.picky.Desc: Guests expect a little more from every stay (expectation +0.1).
keyed.HH.Setting.core.ironBank.Desc: Debt collection always climbs to the highest stage, whatever the difficulty. Nobody quietly defers your instalments.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.noResearchGating.Desc: Everything on the Hearth & Harbor and Silverline trees is available from the start.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.peacefulUnderworld.Desc: Dark venues work without violence: no fight pit, no questioning, no hunting of people, no clinic, no protection racket. Back room, fence and drug lounge stay.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.showMath.Desc: Shows nerd settings and formulas everywhere.
keyed.HH.Setting.core.perfMode.Desc: Guest planning and room checks run half as often. Helps on slow computers; guests may react a little later.
keyed.HH.UI.Calc.slotRtp.Desc: Share of every bet a slot machine pays back on average. The house keeps the rest.
keyed.HH.UI.Page.Sub.overview: Today at a glance: guests, takings and every venue's state.
keyed.HH.UI.Page.Sub.guests: Everyone staying at or visiting your inn. Click a row to jump to the guest; click the handling cell to change it.
keyed.HH.UI.Page.Sub.casino: Houses, takings and how each game is doing against its odds.
keyed.HH.UI.Page.Sub.city: Cinema, salon, gallery, park, taxi and security: what is built and what it earns.
keyed.HH.UI.Page.Sub.underworld: Whispers, arrival weights and the takings of the dark side.

defs.Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_OpeningDay: Three steps from a bed to your first silver. No research, no zones, no settings.
Mark a bed as a guest bed, or put up a venue sign in a roofed room.
Guests only come once you have prepared something for them. Until then the game plays like vanilla.
Wait for the first guests. They arrive within about three days.
You get a letter when a group is on its way.
Let a guest pay for something.
Payments land in the till and are counted on the Overview page.
defs.Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_YourGuests: Where to see how your guests are doing.
Open the Guests page in the Hearth & Harbor tab.
One row per guest: mood, satisfaction, budget and when they leave. Click a row to jump to the guest.
Select a guest and open the Guest tab.
Shows what the guest thinks and lets you pick Basics, Accompany or Recruit.
Try a different handling mode on a guest you like.
defs.Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_FirstVenue: A sign turns a room into a business.
Put up a venue sign inside a roofed room.
Open the sign's Setup tab and build everything marked Required.
Check the opening hours. Guests only buy while it is open.
defs.Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_Bank.label: Money in the bank
defs.Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_Bank.descr: Silverline keeps your takings safe and lets guests pay by card.
defs.Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_Bank.steps: Open a Silverline account at a bank building.
Optional. Without an account the bank stays out of your way.
Switch on direct deposit so the tills empty into the account.
Watch the balance on the Overview page.
defs.MainButtonDef/HH_MainTab.label: hearth & harbor
defs.MainButtonDef/HH_MainTab.description: Guests, venues, income and everything else about running a house for visitors.
